title: Multidimensional Arrays
learning_outcomes: Explain what multidimensional arrays contributes to a PHP application.
Apply at least one of these concepts in a small example: nested arrays.
Check one edge case and explain how to diagnose unexpected behavior.

content.intro: PHP arrays are ordered maps that can represent lists, keyed records, and nested collections. Keys, missing values, sorting, and transformation order all affect the resulting data. In this lesson, focus on nested arrays; then compare it with arrays of records. Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.
content.why_it_matters: You will use multidimensional arrays when building readable, testable PHP programs. Its practical value is knowing which rule applies, what result to expect, and how to handle failure or unexpected input.

common_mistakes.problem: Making several changes at once while debugging.
common_mistakes.why: It becomes difficult to identify which change caused the behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Reduce the issue to one small reproducible case, change one cause, and retest.
